mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, files, chat_id, prompt, content, model_id, create_time FROM chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc

SELECT id, type, api_key as apiKey, model_name as modelName, base_url as baseUrl, disabled, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM chat_model WHERE id = #{modelId} AND (disabled = 0 OR disabled IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music_favorite_directory(name, user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM music_favorite_directory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE music_favorite_directory SET name = #{newName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{oldName}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM music_favorite_list WHERE favorite_id = #{favoriteId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM music_favorite_list WHERE favorite_id = #{favoriteId} AND music_id = #{musicId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music_favorite_list(music_id, favorite_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{musicId}, #{favoriteId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT id, song_name AS songName, author_name AS authorName, album_name AS albumName FROM music WHERE 1 = 1
AND song_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{songName}, '%')
AND author_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{authorName}, '%')
AND album_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{albumName}, '%')
LIMIT #{limit}
